# Saudex Global

> Saudex Global is a Singapore-registered logistics, import/export and freight forwarding company serving businesses across Asia and the Middle East, with a focus on the Singapore–GCC–APAC trade corridor.

Key facts:

- Based in Singapore; main lanes: All over the world
- Modes: sea, air and land freight
- Typical cargo: food & beverage, FMCG, agricultural commodities (incl. palm oil), retail and e-commerce goods
- To get a quote, use the Contact page or email sales

## Services

- [Import & Export](https://saudexglobal.com/services/impo-expo/): Supplier sourcing and coordination for [products/markets]
- [Freight Forwarding](https://saudexglobal.com/services/freight/): Sea, air and land freight on [key lanes]; [FCL/LCL, etc.]
- [Customs Clearance](https://saudexglobal.com/services/customs/): Documentation and compliance for [Singapore/GCC] clearance
- [Warehousing](https://saudexglobal.com/services/warehousing/): Storage and inventory management at [location(s)]
- [Distribution](https://saudexglobal.com/services/distribution/): Last-mile and regional delivery in [regions]
- [FMCG Distribution](https://saudexglobal.com/services/fmcg/): Distribution specifically for consumer goods brands, [how it differs]
- [Supply Chain](https://saudexglobal.com/services/Supply_chain/): Consulting and end-to-end planning

## Industries

- [Food & Beverage](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/food_beverages/): [temperature control, halal, etc.]
- [Agriculture](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/agriculture/): Commodities including palm oil
- [HoReCa](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/horeca/): Supply to hotels, restaurants and catering
- [FMCG](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/fmcg_industry/): Consumer goods logistics
- [Retail](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/retail/): Retail and wholesale support
- [E-Commerce](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/e_commerce/): Fulfilment and shipping
